queries.query: I'm about to publish this blog post about projection rebuilds. Can you run the pre-publish check so people can find it in search and AI answers?

Check our docs SEO: missing-description and duplicate-title baselines are 0, but the title drops the product name and llms.txt/llms-small.txt exceed their byte budgets. What should change before publishing?
Align package/repo metadata: Authors, Company, NuGet project URL, npm homepage, GitHub About topics, Docker Hub descriptions, analyzer helpLinkUri, template messages and README footer docs links.
Our package README starts with a logo and a theatre metaphor. Rewrite the opener so search engines and AI assistants understand what the product is.
Check this landing page for discoverability: does it have a canonical, one h1, a definition above the fold and valid JSON-LD?
Which JSON-LD types should a docs tutorial and a blog post get? May approved public founders be Person nodes, and should community member profiles be noindex without personal structured data?
Make this concept page easier for AI assistants to quote. It opens with a long story before it says what the feature is.
Add one sourced at-a-glance fact block to each entity page, with dated counts and no invented customers, benchmarks, certifications, prices or competitor claims.
Review a product download claim across entry packages and predecessor names: exclude sub-packages, round down and state the month and registries without calling downloads users.
We link to https://cratis.io/chronicle/ from the blog. Is that the right canonical form, and what else should I check before publishing?
Design an llms.txt and Markdown mirrors for the documentation site so assistants retrieve the right page.
Plan our launch: channels, who replies in the threads and how we measure adoption.
Should this tutorial be a tutorial or a how-to, and how do I make it teach like a tour?
This draft sounds like a model wrote it. Make it sound human.
How long should this LinkedIn post be?
Write the release notes for version 15.2.0 with the migration steps.
Explain how Chronicle projections rebuild a read model after an event type changes.
Draft a thread for X announcing the new Arc release with three standalone posts.
